platform: 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1185G7, one thread, core 0

sequential_read_dram_GBps.when: The bytes touched do not fit in cache and are read in address order.

sequential_read_cache_GBps.when: The working set fits in about 32 KiB.

sequential_copy_dram_GBps.when: A large buffer is read and written sequentially. The rate already counts bytes read plus bytes written.

sequential_write_dram_GBps.when: A large buffer is stored sequentially and is not reread.
